title: The Great Escape
question: What is one of the features of modern camping where nationality is concerned?

meanings.usage: 指促使某人做某事的原因，常与for搭配
尤指一次性的初期支出，常与on/upon搭配
修饰可数名词复数，强调数量极多
可形容设备、技术等功能复杂先进
指看似矛盾但可能有其合理性的情况
强调主动刻意避开某人或某事物，后直接接宾语
形容人或地区经济条件优渥
指组织中的层级结构，或处于上层的管理群体
指某事物必然包含或导致某种结果，后接名词/动名词
形容事物质量极高、体验极佳
专门用来形容天气寒冷、下雨等不适宜外出的情况
形容地方有来自世界各地的人，文化多元
指数量上占绝大多数，常与of搭配
指行为导致他人不再友好支持，常用搭配alienate sb from sb

phrases.usage: 表示“远非，完全不”，用于否定某一说法，后可接形容词、动名词或名词

examples.en: It is far from being the only advantage of reading.
examples.zh: 这完全不是阅读的唯一好处。

phrases.usage: 表示“绝不，一点也不”，用于加强否定语气，可置于句首（需倒装）或句中

examples.en: He is by no means an experienced teacher.
examples.zh: 他绝不是一个有经验的老师。

phrases.usage: 表示“密切相关，相伴而生”，说明两个事物同时存在、互相关联

examples.en: Poverty and poor health often go hand in hand.
examples.zh: 贫穷和健康不佳往往是相伴而生的。

phrases.usage: 表示“满足需要，迎合”，主语通常为服务类机构，后接服务对象

examples.zh: 这家餐厅提供素食餐食，满足素食者的需求。

phrases.usage: 表示“提防，警惕”，指对可能的风险或问题保持谨慎

examples.en: You should be wary of strangers who ask for personal information.
examples.zh: 你要警惕索要你个人信息的陌生人。

phrases.usage: 口语常用表达，指“远离尘嚣，彻底放松”，尤指通过度假逃离日常的压力和繁琐

examples.en: Many people go to the countryside on weekends to get away from it all.
examples.zh: 很多人周末去乡下，彻底逃离城市的喧嚣放松自己。

phrases.usage: 表示“在某人的掌控之中，可由某人自由支配”

examples.en: With enough savings, you will have more choices within your command.
examples.zh: 有足够的存款，你就能有更多可以自主选择的机会。

sentences.en: Economy is one powerful motive for camping,
sentences.zh: 经济是露营的一个强大动力，

sentences.en: since after the initial outlay upon equipment, or through hiring it, the total expense can be far less than the cost of hotels.
sentences.zh: 因为在设备初期投入或租用之后，总费用会远低于住酒店的开销。

sentences.en: But, contrary to a popular assumption, it is far from being the only one, or even the greatest.
sentences.zh: 但是，与一种普遍的看法相反，这绝非唯一的，甚至也不是最大的动力。

sentences.en: The man who manoeuvres carelessly into his 20 pounds' worth of space at one of Europe's myriad permanent sites may find himself bumping a Bentley.
sentences.zh: 那个漫不经心地把车开进欧洲无数固定营地之一、仅值20英镑空间的露营者，可能会发现自己的车碰到了宾利。

sentences.en: More likely, Ford Escort will be hub to hub with Renault or Mercedes, but rarely with bicycles made for two.
sentences.zh: 更可能的情况是，福特Escort会和雷诺或梅赛德斯并排停放，但很少会和双人自行车并排。

sentences.en: That the equipment of modern camping becomes yearly more sophisticated is an entertaining paradox for the cynic,
sentences.zh: 现代露营设备每年都变得更加精密，这对愤世嫉俗者来说是一个有趣的悖论，

sentences.en: a brighter promise for the hopeful traveller who has sworn to get away from it all.
sentences.zh: 对发誓要摆脱一切的满怀希望的旅行者来说则是一个更美好的前景。

sentences.en: It also provides--and some student sociologist might care to base his thesis upon the phenomenon--an escape of another kind.
sentences.zh: 它还提供了——某个社会学学生或许会以此现象为基础撰写论文——另一种形式的逃离。

sentences.en: The modern traveller is often a man who dislikes the Splendide and the Bellavista,
sentences.zh: 现代旅行者往往不喜欢“Splendide”和“Bellavista”这样的酒店，

sentences.en: not because he cannot afford, or shuns their material comforts, but because he is afraid of them.
sentences.zh: 不是因为他负担不起或避开它们的物质享受，而是因为他害怕它们。

sentences.en: Affluent he may be, but he is by no means sure what to tip the doorman or the chambermaid.
sentences.zh: 他可能很富裕，但绝不确定该给门童或女服务员多少小费。

sentences.en: Master in his own house he has little idea of when to say boo to a manager hotel.
sentences.zh: 他在自己家里是个主人，却不知道何时该对酒店经理发号施令。

sentences.en: From all such fears camping releases him.
sentences.zh: 露营将他从所有这些恐惧中解脱出来。

sentences.en: Granted, a snobbery of camping itself, based upon equipment and techniques, already exists;
sentences.zh: 诚然，露营本身就存在一种基于装备和技术的势利眼；

sentences.en: but it is of a kind that, if he meets it, he can readily understand and deal with.
sentences.zh: 但如果他遇到这种势利，他也能很容易理解和应对。

sentences.en: There is no superior 'they' in the shape of managements and hotel hierarchies to darken his holiday days.
sentences.zh: 没有以管理层和酒店等级制度形式出现的上级“他们”来给他假期蒙上阴影。

sentences.en: To such motives, yet another must be added.
sentences.zh: 除了这些动机，还必须加上另一个。

sentences.en: The contemporary phenomenon of car worship is to be explained not least by the sense of independence and freedom that ownership entails.
sentences.zh: 当代汽车崇拜现象，其原因很大程度上在于拥有汽车所带来的独立和自由感。

sentences.en: To this pleasure camping gives an exquisite refinement.
sentences.zh: 露营为这种乐趣增添了一种精致的升华。

sentences.en: From one's own front door to home or foreign hills or sands and back again, everything is to hand.
sentences.zh: 从自家门前到国内或国外的山丘沙滩再返回，一切尽在掌握。

sentences.en: Not only are the means of arriving at the holiday paradise entirely within one's own command and keeping,
sentences.zh: 不仅抵达度假天堂的交通工具完全由自己掌控和保管，

sentences.en: but the means of escape from holiday hell (if the beach proves too crowded, the local weather too inclement)
sentences.zh: 而且从度假地狱中逃脱的手段（如果海滩过于拥挤，当地天气过于恶劣）

sentences.en: are there, outside--or, as likely, part of--the tent.
sentences.zh: 就在帐篷外面——或者，更有可能的是，就在帐篷里。

sentences.en: Idealists have objected to the practice of camping, as to the package tour,
sentences.zh: 理想主义者反对露营，就像反对跟团游一样，

sentences.en: that the traveller abroad thereby denies himself the opportunity of getting to know the people of the country visited.
sentences.zh: 认为出国旅行者因此剥夺了自己了解所访国家人民的机会。

sentences.en: Insularity and self-containment, it is argued, go hand in hand.
sentences.zh: 有人认为，与世隔绝和自我封闭是并存的。

sentences.en: The opinion does not survive experience of a popular Continental camping place.
sentences.zh: 但这种观点在体验过一个受欢迎的欧洲大陆露营地后便不攻自破。

sentences.en: Holiday hotels tend to cater for one nationality of visitors especially, sometimes exclusively.
sentences.zh: 度假酒店往往特别迎合——有时甚至专门迎合——某一国籍的游客。

sentences.en: Camping sites, by contrast, are highly cosmopolitan.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，露营地则高度国际化。

sentences.en: Granted, a preponderance of Germans is a characteristic that seems common to most Mediterranean sites;
sentences.zh: 诚然，德国人占多数似乎是大多数地中海营地的共同特点；

sentences.en: but as yet there is no overwhelmingly specialized patronage.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，还没有出现压倒性的专业赞助。

sentences.en: Notices forbidding the open-air drying of clothes,
sentences.zh: 禁止户外晾晒衣物、

sentences.en: or the use of water points for car washing,
sentences.zh: 禁止使用取水点洗车，

sentences.en: or those inviting 'our camping friends' to a dance or a boat trip are printed not only in French or Italian or Spanish, but also in English, German and Dutch.
sentences.zh: 或者邀请“我们的露营朋友”参加舞会或乘船游览的告示，不仅用法语、意大利语或西班牙语印制，也用英语、德语和荷兰语印制。

sentences.en: At meal times the odour of sauerkraut vies with that of garlic.
sentences.zh: 用餐时，酸菜味与大蒜味相互竞争。

sentences.en: The Frenchman's breakfast coffee competes with the Englishman's bacon and eggs.
sentences.zh: 法国人的早餐咖啡与英国人的培根鸡蛋相互抗衡。

sentences.en: Whether the remarkable growth of organized camping means the eventual death of the more independent kind is hard to say.
sentences.zh: 有组织的露营的显著增长是否意味着更独立露营方式的最终消亡，这很难说。

sentences.en: Municipalities naturally want to secure the campers' site fees and other custom.
sentences.zh: 市政府自然希望确保露营者的场地费和其他消费。

sentences.en: Police are wary of itinerants who cannot be traced to a recognized camp boundary or to four walls.
sentences.zh: 警方对那些无法追溯到已认可营地边界或有四面墙壁的流浪者保持警惕。

sentences.en: But most probably it will all depend upon campers themselves: how many heath fires they cause; how much litter they leave;
sentences.zh: 但最有可能的是，这一切都将取决于露营者自己：他们引发了多少荒地火灾；他们留下了多少垃圾；

sentences.en: in short, whether or not they wholly alienate landowners and those who live in the countryside.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，他们是否完全疏远了土地所有者和那些住在乡村的人。

sentences.en: Only good scouting is likely to preserve the freedoms so dear to the heart of the eternal Boy Scout.
sentences.zh: 只有良好的童子军精神才可能维护那些永恒的童子军心中珍爱的自由。

但世界上的某些地方，即使到现在，人们仍然不会书写。
这种兔子在大洋洲没有天敌，因此它以兔子特有的滥交放纵方式大量繁殖。

grammar.title: 形容词/名词前置的倒装结构
grammar.definition: 为了强调表语内容，将作表语的形容词、名词或分词置于句首，形成“表语 + 主语 + be/系动词”的倒装结构，语义等同于正常语序，语气更强烈
grammar.usage: 多用于书面语中，突出强调表语的属性，同时让句子结构更有节奏感

examples.en: Affluent he may be, but he is by no means happy.
examples.zh: 他或许很富裕，但他一点也不快乐。

examples.en: Master in his own house he has little idea of how to deal with public occasions.
examples.zh: 他在自己家里是主人，却完全不知道如何应对公开场合。

grammar.title: 主语从句作主语的结构
grammar.definition: 用完整的句子充当主语，说明整件事的性质或影响，通常用it作形式主语置于句首，将真正的主语从句后置，避免头重脚轻
grammar.structure: It + 系动词 + 名词/形容词 + that引导的主语从句 / That引导的主语从句 + 谓语 + 其他成分
grammar.usage: 用于描述某个事件、情况的属性，that在从句中不充当成分，无实际含义，仅起连接作用

examples.en: That the equipment of modern camping becomes yearly more sophisticated is an entertaining paradox.
examples.zh: 现代露营装备一年比一年精密，这对愤世嫉俗的人来说是个有意思的矛盾现象。

examples.en: It is obvious that regular exercise benefits people's health a lot.
examples.zh: 很明显，定期锻炼对人们的健康大有裨益。

grammar.title: granted作引导词的让步状语结构
grammar.definition: granted（或granted that）作为从属连词，引导让步状语从句，表示“诚然，的确”，先承认某一事实的存在，后面主句引出相反或转折的观点
grammar.structure: Granted (that) + 让步分句, + 主句（表转折）
grammar.usage: 用于议论文中先肯定对立观点的合理性，再阐述自己的核心观点，让论证更客观严谨

examples.en: Granted, a snobbery of camping itself already exists, but it is easy to deal with.
examples.zh: 诚然，露营本身已经存在基于装备和技术的势利现象，但这种情况很容易应对。

examples.en: Granted that this plan has some drawbacks, its advantages far outweigh them.
examples.zh: 诚然这个计划有一些缺点，但它的优点远多于缺点。

patterns.pattern: ... is one powerful motive for..., since...

original.en: Economy is one powerful motive for camping, since after the initial outlay upon equipment, or through hiring it, the total expense can be far less than the cost of hotels.
original.zh: 省钱是露营的一大主要动机，因为除了最初购置装备的费用，或是可以租用装备，总花费要比住酒店便宜得多。

examples.en: Flexibility is one powerful motive for choosing remote work, since you can arrange your schedule according to your own needs.
examples.zh: 灵活性是选择远程工作的一大主要动机，因为你可以根据自己的需求安排日程。

examples.en: Cultural experience is one powerful motive for studying abroad, since you can get immersed in a totally different social environment.
examples.zh: 文化体验是出国留学的一大主要动机，因为你可以沉浸在完全不同的社会环境中。

patterns.pattern: ..., contrary to a popular assumption, it is far from being the only one, or even the greatest.

original.en: But, contrary to a popular assumption, it is far from being the only one, or even the greatest.
original.zh: 但是，和普遍的设想相反，这远不是唯一的动机，甚至算不上是最主要的动机。

examples.en: Many people think high marks mean all for students, but contrary to a popular assumption, it is far from being the only indicator of ability, or even the greatest.
examples.zh: 很多人觉得高分对学生来说意味着一切，但和普遍的设想相反，这远不是能力的唯一指标，甚至算不上是最重要的指标。

examples.en: People often believe that salary is the most important factor for a job, but contrary to a popular assumption, it is far from being the only thing we care about, or even the greatest.
examples.zh: 人们通常认为薪资是工作最重要的因素，但和普遍的设想相反，这远不是我们在意的唯一方面，甚至算不上是最主要的。

patterns.pattern: To such motives, yet another must be added.

original.en: To such motives, yet another must be added.
original.zh: 除了这些动机之外，还有另外一个动机。

examples.en: To such benefits of learning a foreign language, yet another must be added: it helps you understand different ways of thinking.
examples.zh: 除了学习外语的这些好处之外，还要加上另外一点：它能帮助你理解不同的思维方式。

examples.en: To such reasons for the popularity of social media, yet another must be added: it makes it easier to keep in touch with old friends.
examples.zh: 除了社交媒体流行的这些原因之外，还要加上另外一点：它让和老朋友保持联系变得更容易。
